basis: Hand-authored exact printed power, recipients, scopes, thresholds and live-count oracles. Encoded rules are implementation only.

contracts.name: Sprawling Tentacle
contracts.printedText:
Support.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
As long as Sprawling Tentacle is on the field, it gets +1 power if there are at least 4 manifestations in the Confrontation Zone.
selectedClauses: As long as Sprawling Tentacle is on the field, it gets +1 power if there are at least 4 manifestations in the Confrontation Zone.

contracts.name: Prospero of the Bushes
contracts.printedText: As long as Prospero of the Bushes is in the Interzone, the First Manifestation you control gets +1 power for each manifestation in your Interzone.
selectedClauses: As long as Prospero of the Bushes is in the Interzone, the First Manifestation you control gets +1 power for each manifestation in your Interzone.

contracts.printedText:
Adamant.
As long as Berta is on the field, the power of other manifestations on the field cannot be reduced below their base power.

contracts.name: Hyperuranic Tower
contracts.printedText:
When Hyperuranic Tower enters the field, put 3 Abstraction counters on it.
Pay 💧: Move an Abstraction counter from a target card you control to a target Manifestation on the field.
Manifestations you control with one or more Abstraction counters gain Float.
Manifestations with Float you control on the field get +1 power.
selectedClauses: Manifestations you control with one or more Abstraction counters gain Float.
Manifestations with Float you control on the field get +1 power.

contracts.name: Sangen, the Relic
contracts.printedText:
When Sangen wins a confrontation, it enters a target opponent's Interzone under their control.
As long as Sangen is in the Interzone, it cannot be replaced, and all other Manifestations in its controller's Interzone get -1 power.
If at the end of the game Sangen is in the Interzone, its controller gains 25 points.
selectedClauses: all other Manifestations in its controller's Interzone get -1 power.

contracts.name: Kelona, the Anchorite
contracts.printedText:
Cannot be used as tribute.
As long as Kelona is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets -1 power for each card in your Limbo, up to a maximum of -6.
selectedClauses: As long as Kelona is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets -1 power for each card in your Limbo, up to a maximum of -6.

contracts.name: Kazadur, the Fiery
contracts.printedText:
Adamant.
When Kazadur enters the Confrontation Zone, each opponent must Chain from their hand at the same time.
As long as Kazadur is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation controlled by opponents in the Confrontation Zone, up to a maximum of +3.
selectedClauses: As long as Kazadur is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation controlled by opponents in the Confrontation Zone, up to a maximum of +3.
